Class ApiException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
ipossa.ApiException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
final class ApiException extends RuntimeException
Runtime exception used to carry an HTTP status code and message through the lightweight API stack.

Route handlers and utility methods throw this exception when a request should fail with a controlled client or server response.
